description: Grand Prismatic Spring, Yellowstone National Park, Wyoming, USAYellowstone National Park was founded on March 1, 1872, and is considered the world’s first national park. It is located primarily in the state of Wyoming, but also extends into Montana and Idaho. The initiative to establish the park was based on scientific expeditions from 1869 to 1871, which documented the unique landscape. President
